d:
Two brothers. Two paths. Two halves of humanity.
One went west and said "There is only One."
One went east and said "Everything is divine."
The Atharva Veda caught them before they split.
The fourth Veda was rejected for a reason.
It contained a secret that would explain why your Muslim friend prays differently than you do. Why Christians see God as a father. Why Hindus have infinite gods while Islam has one.
The Atharva Veda saw something that happened 3000 years ago, a split that created every religion you know today. Tune in to find more!
